description:
One of the strangest goals in Premier League history. Stan Collymore, Tim Flowers and the whole of Ewood Park are left bemused as a Collymore shot hits a divot on the pitch and bobbles over Tim Flowers to put Liverpool in front.

Premier League game, Season 1995/96.
fulltitle: Stan Collymore scores the strangest goal ever seen at Ewood Park
